summary.text: Chris Chandler, listed by Ballotpedia as Christine Chandler, is a Democratic state representative from District 43 who has represented the district since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an attorney from Los Alamos and chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Chris Chandler received an undergraduate degree from Smith College, a J.D. from Boston College Law School in 1984, and a master's degree in international and comparative law from Georgetown University Law Center.

Ballotpedia lists her career as practice group leader at Los Alamos National Laboratory from 2002 to 2012, senior counsel at Los Alamos National Security, LLC, and partner at Chandler Law of Los Alamos from 2013.
She served on the Los Alamos County Council from 1997 to 2000 and again from 2016 to 2018, and as judge of the Los Alamos County Probate Court from 2013 to 2016.
Chandler took office in the New Mexico House on January 1, 2019.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Rules and Order of Business Committee, the Taxation and Revenue Committee and the House Judiciary Committee, which she chairs.
